scripts.deps:build: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run build --workspace packages/agent && npm run db:generate --workspace packages/server
scripts.build: npm run deps:build && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run bundle --workspace packages/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run deps:build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.vercel:web: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run build --workspace packages/web
scripts.vercel:server: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run db:generate --workspace packages/server && npm run build --workspace packages/server
